name: meter
description: How far along a known range something is, as a thin bar with the amount in words: this period against a target, hours against a budget.

use.when: an amount against a known most or target, read at a glance: a habit this week, a budget spent, storage used.
use.not: work in progress with no known end, which is a status; or numbers over time, which is a chart.
use.with: the same amount in words next to it, and what it measures as its label.

label.description: What it measures, such as Water this week.

max.description: The target or the most; a value past it fills the bar.

words.description: Show what it measures and how much above the bar; false where the same words are beside it already.

text.description: The amount in words, read instead of the bare number: 3 of 8 glasses, 2 hours over.

state.title: How it stands
state.description: going is on the way; met has reached the target; over has gone past a limit.

a11y.role: meter, named by its label, with its amount in words as aria-valuetext

wcag.notes: A meter with its range and value (4.1.2), and the amount in words so a reader hears 3 of 8 glasses rather than 37.5 percent. Met and over are colours on the bar and should be words beside it too (1.4.1). The bar has an edge in forced colours.

machine.identify: aria-valuenow against aria-valuemax is the amount against the target; data-state says met or over.
machine.operate: Nothing to operate; it only shows.
